# Group membership invitation API endpoint
{: .no_toc}



## Table of contents
{: .no_toc .text-delta }

1. TOC
{:toc}

## Endpoints

- **Private portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/users/groupmembershipinvitation/` (needs a token; one record: append `<id>/`)
- **Public portal:** not available
- **Response keys:** `group_membership_invitation` (detail, create, update), `group_membership_invitations` (list)
- **Permissions:** see the [permissions page](/datamodel/permissions/)

## Fields

**[required]** fields must be sent on create; **[read-only]** fields are returned but cannot be set. A *nestable* relation can be traversed in filters (`filter{field.other}`) and sideloaded with `include[]=field.*`; other relations can only be compared with ids (`filter{field}=<id>`). See the [query syntax](/api/#query-parameters).

| Field | Description |
|:------|:------------|
| `id` | UUID string **[read-only]** |
| `user_account_invitation` | [`user`](/api/users/user/) id **[required]** |
| `authgroup` | [`group`](/api/users/group/) id **[required]** |
| `new_manager` | boolean; nullable |
| `new_owner` | boolean; nullable |

## List
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/users/groupmembershipinvitation/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `401` Not authenticated; `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('groupmembershipinvitation', load_all=True)
records = resp['group_membership_invitations']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
resp = client.load('groupmembershipinvitation', 'load_all', true);
records = resp.group_membership_invitations;
```

### Response example
{: .no_toc}

```json
{
    "group_membership_invitations": [
        {
            "id": "<id>",
            "user_account_invitation": "<user-id>",
            "authgroup": "<group-id>",
            "new_manager": true,
            "new_owner": true
        }
    ],
    "meta": {
        "page": 1,
        "per_page": 100,
        "total_results": 1,
        "total_pages": 1
    }
}
```

## Add
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** POST
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/users/groupmembershipinvitation/`
- **Data:** JSON object with at least the required fields
- **Responses:** `201` Created; `400` Bad request (validation errors per field); `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('groupmembershipinvitation', data={"user_account_invitation": "<user-id>", "authgroup": "<group-id>"})
record = resp.json()['group_membership_invitation']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
created = client.save(struct('user_account_invitation', '<user-id>', 'authgroup', '<group-id>'), 'groupmembershipinvitation');
record = created.group_membership_invitation;
```

## Detail
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/users/groupmembershipinvitation/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('groupmembershipinvitation', id='<id>')
record = resp.json()['group_membership_invitation']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
out = client.load('groupmembershipinvitation', 'id', '<id>');
record = out.group_membership_invitation;
```

### Response example
{: .no_toc}

```json
{
    "group_membership_invitation": {
        "id": "<id>",
        "user_account_invitation": "<user-id>",
        "authgroup": "<group-id>",
        "new_manager": true,
        "new_owner": true
    }
}
```

## Change
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** PATCH
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/users/groupmembershipinvitation/<id>/`
- **Data:** JSON object with the fields to change. Lists (`projects`, `tags`, ...) and JSON payloads (`details`, coordinates) are replaced as a whole: read the record first and send the full list or object.
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `400` Bad request; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('groupmembershipinvitation', id='<id>', data={"new_manager": True})
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.save(struct('id', '<id>', 'new_manager', true), 'groupmembershipinvitation', 'method', 'patch');
```

## Delete
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** DELETE
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/users/groupmembershipinvitation/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `204` Deleted; `400` Still referenced by other records; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.delete('groupmembershipinvitation', id='<id>')
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.delete('<id>', 'groupmembershipinvitation');
```

## Custom actions

| Action | Request |
|:-------|:--------|
| `accept_invitation` | POST `/api/private/users/groupmembershipinvitation/<id>/accept/` |
| `cancel_invitation` | POST `/api/private/users/groupmembershipinvitation/<id>/cancel/` |
| `reject_invitation` | POST `/api/private/users/groupmembershipinvitation/<id>/reject/` |
